articles.title: Back-to-Routine: Rebuilding Your Home Fitness Habit After Summer

articles.description: After a summer of disrupted routines, I gained 7 pounds and lost 15% of my strength. Learn how I rebuilt my home fitness habit in just 8 weeks, improving my energy by 30% and maintaining consistency for over 6 months, with actionable steps you can implement today.

articles.description: No gym = no trainer or workout buddies = easy to quit. After failing 6 times to stick with home workouts, here are the 7 motivation systems that finally made it stick for 2+ years.
